arxiv-2211-15730.title: “Stochastic Inverse Problems” and Changes-of-Variables Thanks: This work was supported in part by the NNSA Office of Defense Nuclear Nonproliferation Research and Development, NA-22 F2019 Nuclear Forensics Venture (LA19-V-FY2019-NDD3Ac).
arxiv-2211-15730.creator: Peter W. Marcy, Rebecca E. Morrison
arxiv-2211-15730.description: Abstract Over the last decade, a series of applied mathematics papers have explored a type of inverse problem—called by a variety of names including “inverse sensitivity”, “pushforward based inference”, “consistent Bayesian inference”, or “data-consistent inversion”—wherein a solution is a probability density whose pushforward takes a given form.

arxiv-2403-08968.title: Parameter identification and uncertainty propagation of hydrogel coupled diffusion-deformation using POD-based reduced-order modeling
arxiv-2403-08968.creator: Gopal Agarwal, Jorge-Humberto Urrea-Quintero, Henning Wessels, Thomas Wick
arxiv-2403-08968.description: Abstract This study explores reduced-order modeling for analyzing the time-dependent diffusion-deformation of hydrogels. The full-order model describing hydrogel transient behavior consists of a coupled system of partial differential equations in which chemical potential and displacements are coupled. This system is formulated in a monolithic fashion and solved using the finite element method.

arxiv-2403-17876.title: MIND Your Language: A Multilingual Dataset for Cross-lingual News Recommendation Conference: Proceedings of the 47th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval; July 14–18, 2024; Washington, DC, USA. ISBN: 979-8-4007-0431-4/24/07 DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX CCS:
arxiv-2403-17876.creator: Andreea Iana, Goran Glavaš, Heiko Paulheim
arxiv-2403-17876.description: Abstract . Digital news platforms use news recommenders as the main instrument to cater to the individual information needs of readers. Despite an increasingly language-diverse online community, in which many Internet users consume news in multiple languages, the majority of news recommendation focuses on major, resource-rich languages, and English in particular.

arxiv-2405-15090.title: Pure Exploration for Constrained Best Mixed Arm Identification with a Fixed Budget
arxiv-2405-15090.creator: Dengwang Tang, Rahul Jain, Ashutosh Nayyar, Pierluigi Nuzzo
arxiv-2405-15090.description: Abstract In this paper, we introduce the constrained best mixed arm identification (CBMAI) problem with a fixed budget. This is a pure exploration problem in a stochastic finite armed bandit model. Each arm is associated with a reward and multiple types of costs from unknown distributions.

arxiv-2406-05416.title: Focussing of concentric free-surface waves
arxiv-2406-05416.creator: Lohit Kayal 1, Vatsal Sanjay 2, Nikhil Yewale 1, Anil Kumar 1, Ratul Dasgupta 1
arxiv-2406-05416.description: Abstract Gravito-capillary waves at free-surfaces are ubiquitous in several natural and industrial processes involving quiescent liquid pools bounded by cylindrical walls. These waves emanate from the relaxation of initial interface distortions, which often take the form of a cavity (depression) centred on the symmetry axis of the container.

arxiv-2411-06031.title: Existence and non-existence of normalized solutions for a nonlinear fractional Schrödinger system Thanks: The first author was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (Grant No.12171108). The third author was supported by the Guangdong Basic and Applied Basic Research Foundatio
arxiv-2411-06031.description: Abstract . This paper is concerned with a nonlinear fractional Schördinger system in ℝ \mathbb{{R}} with intraspecies interactions a i > 0 ​ ( i = 1 , 2 ) a_{i}>0\ (i=1,2) and interspecies interactions β ∈ ℝ \beta\in\mathbb{{R}} . We study this system by solving an associated constrained minimization problem (i.e., L 2 − L^{2}- norm constaints).

arxiv-2505-06042.title: Learning Music Audio Representations With Limited Data Thanks: Christos Plachouras is supported by UK Research and Innovation [grant number EP/S022694/1].
arxiv-2505-06042.creator: Christos Plachouras, Emmanouil Benetos, Johan Pauwels
arxiv-2505-06042.description: Abstract Large deep-learning models for music, including those focused on learning general-purpose music audio representations, are often assumed to require substantial training data to achieve high performance. If true, this would pose challenges in scenarios where audio data or annotations are scarce, such as for underrepresented music traditions, non-popular genres, and personalized music creation and listening.

arxiv-2506-18231.title: NIKA2 Cosmological Legacy Survey
arxiv-2506-18231.creator: D. Chérouvrier, J. F. Macías-Pérez, F. X. Désert, R. Adam, P. Ade, H. Ajeddig, S. Amarantidis, P. André, H. Aussel, R. Barrena, A. Beelen, A. Benoît, S. Berta, M. Béthermin, A. Bongiovanni, J. Bounmy, O. Bourrion, L. -J. Bing, M. Calvo, A. Catalano, M. De Petris, S. Doyle, E. F. C. Driessen, G. Ejla
arxiv-2506-18231.description: Abstract Clusters of galaxies, formed in the latest stages of structure formation, are unique cosmological probes. With the advent of large CMB surveys like those from the Planck satellite, the ACT and SPT telescopes, we now have access to a large number of galaxy clusters detected at millimeter wavelengths via the thermal Sunyaev-Zel’dovich (tSZ) effect.

arxiv-2509-03764.title: LLM-based Relevance Assessment for Web-Scale Search Evaluation at Pinterest DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: The 19th ACM Recommender Systems Conference; September 22–26, 2025; Prague, Czech Republic RecSys 2025 EARL Workshop, September 22–26, 2025, Prague, Czech Republic ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/201
arxiv-2509-03764.creator: Han Wang, Alex Whitworth, Pak Ming Cheung, Zhenjie Zhang, Krishna Kamath
arxiv-2509-03764.description: Abstract . Relevance evaluation plays a crucial role in personalized search systems to ensure that search results align with a user’s queries and intent. While human annotation is the traditional method for relevance evaluation, its high cost and long turnaround time limit its scalability.

arxiv-2510-27544.title: Mechanics of Learned Reasoning 1: TempoBench , A Benchmark for Interpretable Deconstruction of Reasoning System Performance
arxiv-2510-27544.creator: Nikolaus Holzer, William Fishell, Baishakhi Ray, Mark Santolucito
arxiv-2510-27544.description:
A 2025 arXiv research paper by Nikolaus Holzer, William Fishell, Baishakhi Ray, Mark Santolucito. Abstract

Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly excelling and outpacing human performance on many tasks. However, to improve LLM reasoning, researchers either rely on ad-hoc generated datasets or formal mathematical proof systems such as the Lean proof assistant. Whilst ad-hoc generated methods can capture the decision chains of real-world reasoning processes, they may encode some inadvertent bias in the space of reasoning they cover; they also cannot be formally verified.

arxiv-2512-03746.title: Thinking with Programming Vision: Towards a Unified View for Thinking with Images
arxiv-2512-03746.creator: Zirun Guo 1,2 Minjie Hong 1 Feng Zhang 2 Kai Jia 2 Tao Jin 1 1 Zhejiang University 2 ByteDance, BandAI
arxiv-2512-03746.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zirun Guo 1,2 Minjie Hong 1 Feng Zhang 2 Kai Jia 2 Tao Jin 1 1 Zhejiang University 2 ByteDance, BandAI. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that “think with images” can interactively use tools to reason about visual inputs, but current approaches often rely on a narrow set of tools with limited real-world necessity and scalability.

arxiv-2601-10464.title: MitoFREQ: A Novel Approach for Mitogenome Frequency Estimation from Top-level Haplogroups and Single Nucleotide Variants Journal: arXiv
arxiv-2601-10464.creator: Mikkel Meyer Andersen, Nicole Huber, Kimberly S Andreaggi, Tóra Oluffa Stenberg Olsen, Walther Parson, Charla Marshall
arxiv-2601-10464.description: Abstract Forensic lineage markers pose a challenge in forensic genetics as their evidential value can be difficult to quantify. Lineage marker population frequencies can serve as one way to express evidential value. However, for some markers, e.g., high-quality whole mitochondrial DNA genome sequences (mitogenomes), population data remain limited.

arxiv-2602-02378.title: From Sycophancy to Sensemaking: Premise Governance for Human–AI Decision Making
arxiv-2602-02378.creator: Raunak Jain, Mudita Khurana, John Stephens, Srinivas Dharmasanam, Shankar Venkataraman

europmc-pmc6786777.title: EBMT-NIH-CIBMTR Task Force position statement on standardized terminology & guidance for graft-versus-host disease assessment.
europmc-pmc6786777.creator: Schoemans HM, Lee SJ, Ferrara JL, Wolff D, Levine JE, Schultz KR, Shaw BE, Flowers ME, Ruutu T, Greinix H, Holler E, Basak G, Duarte RF, Pavletic SZ, EBMT (European Society for Blood and Marrow Transplantation) Transplant Complications Working Party and the “EBMT−NIH (National Institutes of Health)−CIBMTR (Center for International Blood and Marrow Transplant Research) GvHD Task Force”.

This position statement by GvHD experts from the European Society for Blood and Marrow Transplantation (EBMT), the National Institutes

pmc-10611905.title: Collagen Content and Collagen Fiber Architecture in the Skin of Shamo Chicken, a Japanese Game Fowl
pmc-10611905.creator: Shotaro Nishimura, Sayaka Arai, Yoshinao Z Hosaka
pmc-10611905.description: Collagen content and collagen fiber architecture in the skin of Shamo chickens were compared between sexes and body parts. Cervical, thoracic, dorsal, femoral, and crural skin samples were collected and their collagen content was analyzed. Collagen fiber specimens were prepared for scanning electron microscopy using the cell maceration method with a NaOH solution.

pmc-10652364.title: Crystal Structure, Hirshfeld Surface Analysis, and Biological Activities of Schiff-Base Derivatives of 4-Aminoantipyrine
pmc-10652364.creator: Esteban Aguilar-Llanos, Saskya E Carrera-Pacheco, Rebeca González-Pastor, Johana Zúñiga-Miranda, Cristina Rodríguez-Pólit, Arianna Mayorga-Ramos, Oscar Carrillo-Naranjo, Linda P Guamán, Juan Carlos Romero-Benavides, Carlos Cevallos-Morillo, Gustavo A Echeverría, Oscar E Piro, Christian D Alcívar-Leó
pmc-10652364.description: Eight Schiff bases, synthesized by the reaction of 4-aminoantipyrine with different cinnamaldehydes, were studied in the solid state by using vibrational spectroscopy (IR) and X-ray diffraction techniques. The analysis was extended to the solution phase through ultraviolet–vis, fluorescence spectroscopy, and cyclic voltammetry. Finally, the crystal structures of four compounds (3b, 3d, 3g, and 3h) were determined and studied.

pmc-10655178.title: MicroRNA-Mediated Host Immune Genes Manipulation Benefits AcMNPV Proliferation in Spodoptera frugiperda
pmc-10655178.creator: Jie Zhang, Junaid Zafar, Jinrong Kong, Fei Wang, Xuehua Shao, Ruonan Zhang, Rui Pang, Hanhong Xu, Xiaoxia Xu, Fengliang Jin
pmc-10655178.description: Spodoptera frugiperda is a highly destructive migratory pest that threatens various crops globally. Autographa californica multiple nucleopolyhedrovirus (AcMNPV) is an effective biocontrol agent against lepidopteran pests. Here, we explored the molecular mechanisms underlying the immune response to AcMNPV infection in S. frugiperda.

pmc-10859741.title: Essential Health Services Delivery Status During COVID-19 Pandemic in Ethiopia: A National Mixed-Methods Survey of Primary Healthcare Units
pmc-10859741.creator: Elias Ali Yesuf, Biru Abdisa, Habtamu Sime, Enku Kifle Alemu, Netsanet Abera Asseffa, Meskerem Jisso, Alemu Tamiso, Akalewold Alemayehu, Rekiku Fikre, Abdurezak Umer, Mesfin Kebede, Hussen Mohammed, Bekele Yazie, Kassu Ketema Gurmu, Kassahun Dessie Gashu, Dessies Abebaw Angaw, Berhanu Fikadie Endeha
pmc-10859741.description: BackgroundEssential health services are a package of services critical to improve health outcomes. COVID-19 pandemic disrupts essential health services. However, the level of essential health service disruption due to COVID-19 in Ethiopia is not clear. This study aimed at measuring the status of delivery of essential health services in Ethiopia during COVID-19.MethodsA national mixed-methods cross-sectional survey was conducted.

pmc-11336005.title: Which heart failure patients benefit most from non-invasive telemedicine? An overview of current evidence and future directions
pmc-11336005.creator: Jorna van Eijk, Kim Luijken, Jaap Trappenburg, Tiny Jaarsma, Folkert W. Asselbergs
pmc-11336005.description: Telemedicine in heart failure (HF) management may positively impact health outcomes, but varied effects in studies hinder guidance in HF guidelines. Evidence on the effectiveness of telemedicine in HF subpopulations is limited. We conducted a scoping review to evaluate and synthesise evidence on the effectiveness of telemedicine across HF subpopulations that could guide telemedicine strategies in routine practice.

pmc-11395734.title: Unifying antimicrobial peptide datasets for robust deep learning-based classification
pmc-11395734.creator: Shuang Peng, Loïc Rajjou
pmc-11395734.description: Leguminous crops are vital to sustainable agriculture due to their ability to fix atmospheric nitrogen, improving soil fertility and reducing the need for synthetic fertilizers. Additionally, they are an excellent source of protein for both human consumption and animal feed.

pmc-11654428.title: Priming grapevines with oregano essential oil vapour results in a metabolomic shift eliciting resistance against downy mildew
pmc-11654428.creator: Ana Cecilia Aliaga Fandino, Nicolas Vigneron, Esteban Alfonso, Jean-Philippe Burdet, Eric Remolif, Amanda Malvessi Cattani, Tara Smit-Sadki, Stéphanie Cluzet, Josep Valls-Fonayet, Pierre Pétriacq, Markus Rienth
pmc-11654428.description: BackgroundPriming plants with natural products is extensively studied in the agricultural field to reduce the use of synthetic and copper-based pesticides. Previous studies have shown that Oregano essential oil vapour (OEOV) is an effective priming agent against downy mildew (DM) in grapevine (Vitis vinifera L. cv. Chasselas), activating different transcriptomic regulated defence mechanisms.

pmc-12368265.title: Chromosome-level genome assembly and annotation of Amur Pike (Esox reichertii)
pmc-12368265.creator: Yuyong Zhang, Yongquan Zhang, Tangbin Huo, Gerel Qogt, Ping Zhang, Huiping Zhang, Zhiying Jia
pmc-12368265.description: Amur pike (Esox reicherti) is endemic to the Heilongjiang River system in Northeast Asia. Serving as a top predator in its ecosystem, Amur pike carries substantial significance in ecological, economic, and cultural dimensions. Molecular studies have firmly established that Esociformes is the sister group of Salmoniformes. Notably, unlike Salmoniformes, Esociformes has not undergone genomic duplication.

pmc-12523341.title: Applicability of Raman Spectroscopy for the Assessment of Wheat Flour Quality and Functionality in Bakery Applications
pmc-12523341.creator: Justine Van der Vennet, Fien De Witte, Peter Vandenabeele, Mia Eeckhout, Filip Van Bockstaele, Cleiton Antonio Nunes, Yhan Da Silva Mutz
pmc-12523341.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Advancements in Raman spectroscopy have broadened the utilization possibilities for food applications. The present review covers the working principle and methodology of the emerging technique in the context of wheat (flour) as a bakery ingredient. Special attention is paid to the primary constituents of wheat flour, starch and gluten proteins, both in their isolated forms and within complex matrices such as flour, dough, and various end products.

pmc-12566359.title: Dynamic Imaging of Lipid Order and Heterogeneous Microviscosity in Mitochondrial Membranes of Potato Tubers Under Abiotic Stress
pmc-12566359.creator: Vadim N Nurminsky, Svetlana I Shamanova, Olga I Grabelnych, Natalia V Ozolina, Yuguang Wang, Alla I Perfileva, Mariana Ferreira
pmc-12566359.description: Microviscosity and lipid order are the main parameters characterizing the phase states of the membrane. Variations in microviscosity and lipid composition in a living cell may indicate serious disturbances, including various kinds of stress. In this work, the effect of hyperosmotic stress on the microviscosity of mitochondrial membranes was investigated, using potato (Solanum tuberosum L.) tuber mitochondria.

pmc-12962023.title: Effectiveness of 2024/25 KP.2 Vaccine Against Outpatient COVID‐19 in Canada
pmc-12962023.creator: Lea Separovic, Suzana Sabaiduc, Yuping Zhan, Samantha E Kaweski, Sara Carazo, Romy Olsha, Richard G Mather, Christine Lacroix, Maan Hasso, Inès Levade, Isabelle Meunier, Agatha N Jassem, Katie Dover, Ruimin Gao, Nathalie Bastien, Danuta M Skowronski
pmc-12962023.description: The Canadian Sentinel Practitioner Surveillance Network used the test‐negative design to assess KP.2 vaccine effectiveness (VE) against medically attended outpatient COVID‐19 between November 2024 and April 2025 among participants ≥ 12 years. Analyses included 5410 controls (19% vaccinated) and 435 COVID‐19 cases (10% vaccinated). Nearly three‐quarters (72%) of contributing case viruses were genetically characterized, with XEC (35%) and KP.3.1.

pmc-13256200.title: Comparative Extraction of Polyphenolic Co-Pigments and Proteins from Annatto (Bixa orellana L.) Seed By-Products
pmc-13256200.creator: Elsa F. Vieira, Pamela Ramires, Manuela M. Moreira, Cristina Delerue-Matos
pmc-13256200.description: Annatto (Bixa orellana L.) seed by-products (ASBs), generated after industrial pigment extraction, remain a largely underexplored source of bioactive compounds, including residual carotenoids, phenolics, and proteins. This study compares three extraction strategies—maceration (ME), ultrasound-assisted extraction (UAE), and subcritical water extraction (SWE)—for the recovery of these compounds from ASB within a green processing framework.

pmc-13296929.title: Frailty-Driven Prediction of Inpatient Obstructive Sleep Apnea and Related Sleep Disorder Diagnoses Using Explainable AI
pmc-13296929.creator: Assiya Boltaboyeva, Bibars Amangeldy, Zhanel Baigarayeva, Baglan Imanbek, Nurdaulet Tasmurzayev, Adilet Kakharov, Sultan Tuleukhanov, Zhanar Omirbekova, Balzhan Makhatova
pmc-13296929.description: Background/Objectives: Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and related sleep disorders affect a substantial proportion of hospitalized patients, with an estimated 48% pooled prevalence of undiagnosed OSA in cardiac inpatients and up to 80% of moderate-to-severe community OSA cases carrying no formal diagnosis at the time of hospital admission.

pmc-13529193.title: Pancytopenia as the Initial Presentation of Celiac Disease
pmc-13529193.creator: Ponn Karthikeyan Saravanamuthu, Anup Kumar Das
pmc-13529193.description: Celiac disease is an immune-mediated enteropathy precipitated by gluten in genetically susceptible individuals. Although diarrhea, weight loss, and malabsorption are classical features, extraintestinal presentations are increasingly recognized. Pancytopenia as the initial manifestation of adult celiac disease is rare and often delays diagnosis.

pmc-13563775.title: Constrained acetabular liner total hip arthroplasty versus conventional hemiarthroplasty for unstable comminuted femoral intertrochanteric fractures in elderly patients with neurological disorders
pmc-13563775.creator: Mingming Dong, Yandan Liu, Congcong Wei

pmc-13631386.title: ‘Certainly not in the heterosexual public eye’: Qualitative study of the contexts of syphilis transmission among heterosexually-identifying people in England
pmc-13631386.creator: Megan Walsh, David Reid, Josh Forde, Lynsey Emmett, Medhat Basta, David Phillips, Malini Raychaudhuri, Freddy Green, Will Nutland, Alison R. Howarth, Mateo Prochazka, Gwenda Hughes, Kirsty Foster, Catherine H. Mercer, Hamish Mohammed
pmc-13631386.description: BackgroundRecent increases in syphilis diagnoses among heterosexual individuals are a growing public health concern. The NEXUS study aimed to qualitatively assess the contexts surrounding syphilis transmission among heterosexually-identifying individuals in England.MethodsWe conducted semi-structured interviews with heterosexually-identifying individuals diagnosed with primary, secondary, or early latent syphilis in the previous year, and with healthcare professionals (HCPs) involved in syphilis management.

pmc-13658264.title: Primary adrenal small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma in a patient with sarcoidosis and synchronous colon adenocarcinoma
pmc-13658264.creator: Asami Sano, Tetsu Takeichi, Akio Miyamaoto, Yutaka Nishii, Teppei Yamamoto, Yukiko Kusama
pmc-13658264.description: Primary adrenal neuroendocrine carcinoma (NEC), particularly the small cell subtype, is exceptionally rare. In patients with sarcoidosis, inflammatory lymphadenopathy may mimic a metastatic disease, making disease detection difficult. A 76-year-old man with sarcoidosis was referred for an enlarging left adrenal incidentaloma that had increased in size from 7 mm to 19 × 14 mm over 3 years.
